author: B.Meyer, 1822
summary: 흰갈매기보다 몸이 뚜렷하게 작은 갈매기이다. 다리도 흰갈매기보다 짧아서 앉아 있을 때 키 차이가 잘 드러난다. 유럽 북서부와 북아메리카 북동부에 분포한다.

points.en: short bill with a weak gonys angle

points.ko: 살구색으로 서서히 번지는 검은 부리 끝
points.en: black bill tip fading gradually into an apricot base
primaries projecting well beyond the tail tip

sexes.text: 암수 생김새가 같고 수컷이 조금 크다.

young: 첫겨울 어린새는 온몸이 연한 크림색이나 옅은 회갈색이고 등과 날개덮깃에 잔 갈색 무늬가 고르게 있으며, 첫째날개깃도 몸만큼 옅다. 부리는 처음에 거의 검다가 차츰 기부부터 옅어지며, 북아메리카 서부형(thayeri)은 전체가 이보다 짙다.

similar.how: 작은흰갈매기가 뚜렷이 작고 부리가 짧으며, 부리 끝 검은색이 기부의 살구색으로 서서히 옅어진다(흰갈매기는 검은 부분이 좁고 경계가 뚜렷하다). 머리 윗부분이 둥글고(흰갈매기는 평평하다), 접은 첫째날개깃이 꽁지 끝보다 뚜렷이 길게 나오며(흰갈매기는 조금 길 뿐이다), 다리가 짧아 앉은 키가 낮다.

art.subject: Iceland Gull (Larus glaucoides), first-winter, as seen on Korean coasts in winter (December–March): whole bird very pale, creamy-white to pale buff-grey, finely and evenly mottled pale brown on the back and wing coverts; head and underparts almost plain pale buffy-white; primaries whitish, as pale as or paler than the rest of the wing; tail pale with faint brown mottling; bill short, black on the outer part blending gradually into a pinkish-apricot base; iris dark brown; legs pink.
art.pose: standing with wings folded, side view
art.scene: Korean east-coast sandy shore in winter (January), grey sea and wet sand under an overcast sky; no people, buildings or text
views: first-winter, side view standing: rounded head, very pale creamy plumage finely mottled pale brown, whitish primaries projecting well beyond the tail, short bill with a black outer part blending into an apricot base, dark brown iris, short pink legs
first-winter, head detail in profile: domed rounded crown, short bill with a weak gonys angle, black tip fading gradually into an apricot-pink base, dark brown iris
art.build: Medium-large white-winged gull, clearly smaller and slimmer than Glaucous Gull and a little smaller than Vega Gull, with a gentle expression. Head small and rounded with a domed crown. Bill short and fairly slender, with only a weak gonys angle. Legs short, so the bird sits low. Wings long: at rest the folded primaries project well beyond the tail tip. In flight the wings look all pale with no dark tips.
avoid: Do not paint a large pink bill with a sharply cut-off black tip; that is Glaucous Gull (Larus hyperboreus), which also has a flat crown and short primary projection.
Do not paint black or dark grey wingtips; the primaries are whitish.
Do not paint long legs or a large, angular head.
Do not give it an adult yellow bill with a red spot or a pale iris; the bird shown is first-winter.
